name: @app/remote-chat-agent
description: The remote chat agent service: one Rust binary (rs/, crate rca-service: the adapters and the front door; the use cases and ports in service-core/, the thread domain in core/, the CLI driver, the executor channel and the agent API dispatch in cli-driver/, exec-channel/ and agent-core/) and its flow tests (rs/tests/flow.rs). The TypeScript here is its e2e and benchmark suites; nothing of the service itself.

scripts.test:unit: cargo test --locked -p remote-chat-agent-render -p remote-chat-agent-opencode -p remote-chat-agent-speech -p remote-chat-agent-host -p remote-chat-agent-core -p rca-cli-driver -p rca-exec-channel -p rca-agent-core -p rca-group-agent -p rca-group-workspace -p rca-group-state -p rca-group-accounts -p rca-group-terminal -p rca-group-git -p rca-group-hosted -p rca-group-schedules -p rca-group-attachments -p rca-group-catalog -p rca-group-preview -p rca-service-core --lib --manifest-path Cargo.toml
scripts.test:verify:deployed: REMOTE_CHAT_AGENT_BASE_URL=${REMOTE_CHAT_AGENT_BASE_URL:-http://remote-chat-agent-prod:8787} vitest run tests/e2e --config vitest.e2e.config.ts && cargo test --locked -p rca-service --test deployed_verification --manifest-path Cargo.toml -- --ignored
